EverGrandeCity_HallOfFame_Text_HereWeHon:
WALLACE: This room…
This is where we keep records of POKéMON that prevailed through harsh battles.
It is here that the LEAGUE CHAMPIONS are honored.
EverGrandeCity_HallOfFame_Text_LetsRecor: WALLACE: Come on, let's record your name as a TRAINER who triumphed over the POKéMON LEAGUE, and the names of the partners who battled with you.
